scenes.say: Three doors, one car. The host opens an empty one. Your gut says it's fifty-fifty. Your gut is wrong.
This puzzle made mathematicians write angry letters. It's named after game show host Monty Hall.
Your first pick had a one-in-three chance. The host knows where the car is, so the other two-thirds pile onto the last door.
scenes.show: The host's knowledge moves the odds.
